name: ultracode work
description: Ultracode at rest, the dominant state: three dancers, each in its own breathing neon purple aura, run through formations on a four frame beat (a triangle, a line holding hands, an upside down triangle that turns, a column, a figure eight reel, a wiggling totem, an orbit, back to the triangle), hopping together and pinging round robin; judge whether it reads as a team at work and whether the moves stay legible at 20 cells.
